distribution.title: Data will be collected to assess the impact of gamified learning on both learning outcomes and learner engagement

dmp.description: This project aims to develop a gamified tool to improve decision-making in Information Systems (IS) integration during mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The tool, based on gamification elements, will provide an interactive platform for M&A practitioners to simulate integration scenarios and refine their decision-making strategies. The scientific objective is to bridge the gap between theoretical IS integration methodologies and practical applications through an innovative training solution.
